brief:
Two Israelis were wounded in an alleged ramming attack at a military checkpoint south of Nablus in the occupied West Bank on Monday, Middle East Eye reported. The incident occurred at a checkpoint in the southern part of the territory.

Israeli media confirmed the attack but provided no immediate details on the condition of the wounded or circumstances surrounding the ramming.
dek: Two wounded in alleged car-ramming at West Bank checkpoint: Israeli report Two Israelis were wounded in an alleged ramming attack at a military checkpoint south of Nablus in the occupied West Bank on Monday, Israeli media reported.
title: Car ramming wounds two Israelis at West Bank checkpoint
